question: is revenue up or down compared to last month?
gold_sql: SELECT 'this_month' p, ROUND(SUM(j.credit-j.debit),0) revenue FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_REVENUE','NON_OPERATING_REVENUE') AND j.post_date>='2026-06-01' AND j.post_date<'2026-07-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'last_month', ROUND(SUM(j.credit-j.debit),0) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_REVENUE','NON_OPERATING_REVENUE') AND j.post_date>='2026-05-01' AND j.post_date<'2026-06-01'
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT SUM(credit - debit) AS revenue, DATE_FORMAT(post_date, ?) AS month
FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id = j.account_id
WHERE a.account_type IN (?, ?)
GROUP BY month
